querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      f_info_windcode,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      f_type_code,
                                      f_type_name,
                                      f_fixed_investment_cycle,
                                      f_fixed_amount,
                                      f_purchase_rate,
                                      f_dividend_method,
                                      f_avgreturn_thisyear,
                                      f_sfrank_recentyeart,
                                      f_annualyeild_thisyear,
                                      f_recentyeart_thisyear,
                                      f_avgreturn_twoyear,
                                      f_sfrank_recentyeart_twosyear,
                                      f_annualyeild_twosyear,
                                      f_annualyeild_twoyear,
                                      f_avgreturn_threeyear,
                                      f_sfrank_threesyear,
                                      f_annualyeild_threesyear,
                                      f_annualyeild_threeyear,
                                      f_avgreturn_fiveyear,
                                      f_sfrank_recentyeart_fivesyear,
                                      f_annualyeild_fivesyear,
                                      f_annualyeild_fiveyear,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_cmffixedinvestmentrate.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.cmffixedinvestmentrate WHERE trade_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
